newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - Nov 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - Nov 11.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Ching Hua university student drowns in a lake after rescuing a schoolgirl.
Heavy rains in eastern Hualien county kill two and injure five.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Heavy rains in Hualien kill two, leaving three missing.
Fewer Taiwanese students study in Australia because of racial discrimination.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Ruling Nationalist Party plans to invest in Japan's Okinawa through its holding company.
Southern Kaohsiung will be the main hub for air and shipping links between Taiwan and China.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwan will review its tax system to avoid double-taxing foreign investors.
Taiwan's 1996 trade surplus is expected to reach a five-year high, helping the economic growth.
